title: Mary Beth B Possible NDE 23387
content: I was born without a grownup tooth under a baby tooth. So, when I was almost 20 I had a procedure where I got my wisdom teeth taken out as well as a bone graph to build up my gum for a dental implant. My Oral Surgeon and I had a pleasant rapport with each other. I was a little nervous about the procedure so he suggested laughing gas. The last thing I remember was him saying 'Crank that $h#t up!' After a few seconds of inhaling the gas, I felt ANGRY and SCARED. I wanted to rip the mask off of my face but I couldn't move or talk. I remember tears streaming down my face. And then came the loud sound like a freight train. The next thing I knew, I was out of my body and flying in circles around the room. I saw myself, the Doctor, and the nurses. Then I flew through the ceiling and up into the sky. I went up, up, and up, until I was in SPACE. There were stars are all around me as I was just floating. The freight train sound turned into the most amazing electronic dance music song. I was dancing in the stars. I am thinking 'Oh, my gosh, I am dead! They killed me.' BUT I felt so euphoric! So faintly in the electronic song, I could hear, 'Mary Beth?' The it got LOUDER, 'Mary Beth? MARY BETH? You feeling okay? Okay? OKAY? OKAY?' I kept hearing the word 'okay' over and over and over. Then I could feel myself being shaken. I quickly came to. I was confused. There were about five nurses hovering over me. I heard, 'You scared us!' Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2008 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Surgery-related Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw my feet and arms when I was dancing. I was in human form while in space. Otherwise, I was like a ball until I exited the Earth's atmosphere. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was on Nitrous Oxide Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. It felt like I was out for a LONG time. But I probably was out about 30 minutes in reality. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I heard a loud sound like a freight train, and I heard techno music. Then tI heard he nurses' voices trying to wake me up. They were fading in and out of my music. I just remember everything sounded SO LOUD. Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. My sense of sound was heightened What emotions did you feel during the experience? Euphoria, peaceful, and light, Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control Did scenes from the future come to you? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Not as religious as I am now presently What is your religion now? Conservative/fundamentalist Christian/Catholic Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? No Response After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The worst part was the initial ANGER I felt. I wanted to scream. I could not talk or move. So, I guess that I escaped. The best part was dancing in the stars. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Uncertain At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? None

environment.environment_other_detail: Outer space with stars all around; experience centered on extremely loud sound/techno music.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Dental procedure with nitrous oxide (wisdom teeth removal and bone graft).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Auditory phenomena: freight-train sound transforming into electronic dance music; nurses' voices fading in/out.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Anger/fear and loud sound preceded OBE; then flying around room, then space; return triggered by hearing name and being shaken.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Freight-train sound transitioned into 'the most amazing electronic dance music song' while floating/dancing among stars; reported shifting self-form ('ball' until exiting Earth's atmosphere, then human form in space).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Crank that $h#t up!” “Oh, my gosh, I am dead! They killed me.” “Mary Beth? MARY BETH? You feeling okay? Okay? OKAY? OKAY?”
